about: Rooted in Kindness is a curl-specialist hair studio inside Salon Lofts in Austin, TX — run by independent stylist Shelby. Services include curly haircuts, custom color, dry cuts and vivid color, by appointment. Find them on Instagram @rooted.in.kindness.
address: Salon Lofts – Plaza Volente, Loft No. 8, 11521 N FM 620, Suite 500, Austin, TX 78726
